data: What is the approximate maximum value of the green line in the right graph?

The right graph shows the number of parameters for three models: n-CP, n-TuckER, and GETD, evaluated on WikiPeople-4. The green line represents the n-CP model. To determine the approximate maximum value of the green line, I need to focus on the y-axis, which is labeled "Number of Parameters" and uses a logarithmic scale. The green line reaches its highest point at approximately \(10^7\) parameters. Therefore, the approximate maximum value of the green line is \(10^7\).
